column4: Power Nap on, tcpkeepalive on, standby on, sleep 1 min, hibernatemode 3 (battery and AC). Restore these at teardown if changed
Chrome and swiftDialog installed by policy automation on AC, lid open. Chrome took 8 min including one restart caused by MDM enrollment
Reproduced: download started in a 2 s DarkWake, read tcp error at the next DarkWake 17 min later, Fleet shows Software installer download failed
Fleet retried once after the failure. The retry waited for the lid to open and installed 83 s after the wake
Install queued in a DarkWake but never reached fleetd. An FMA update to 3.1.1 at 17:37Z dropped it silently and nothing re-queued it. Small download not tested, rerun needed
